summary: P&O Phase 2 Round 2 (WBS + Activity Schedule + Resource Planning) — backend 18/18 PASS (6 baseline iter99 + 6 new extra coverage iter99 + 6 iter98 regression), frontend e2e fully verified. Sidebar shows all 3 new entries ('Work Breakdown (WBS)', 'Activity Schedule', 'Resource Planning'). All 3 new pages render with correct data-testids, project dropdowns populate (19 projects), Add buttons appear only after project select (correct UX). Resource Planning shows 5 summary tiles (Manpower / Material / Tools / Sub-Contract / Grand Total) with line counts; all 4 tabs (Manpower/Material/Tools/Sub-Contract) clickable. Phase 1 regression — all 9 P&O pages (/dashboard /projects-master /site-master /work-orders /team /documents /timeline /planning /boq) load without error.

design_issues.screen: All pages with <select> dropdowns (Phase 1 + Phase 2 R1 + R2)
issues: React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This is generated by Emergent visual-editor instrumentation (data-ve-dynamic / x-source-* attributes injected into JSX <option> tags) and is reproducible across many existing pages (ProjectDocuments, Planning, BOQ etc.). Non-blocking, no functional impact. Already documented in iter98 — no fix required from main agent.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend router (projects_ops_phase2r2_router.py) is clean: ObjectId stripped via {_id:0} projection on every read, async/await used throughout, audit hooks wired on create/delete (note: PUT endpoints for WBS/Activity/Resource do NOT call audit — minor inconsistency vs Round 1; consider for next round).

WBS cascade delete is correct (BFS via frontier) and properly unlinks downstream activities/resources by setting wbs_id=None instead of orphaning — confirmed in test_wbs_delete_cascades_unlinks_activities_and_resources.
Activity predecessor cleanup on DELETE uses $pull across all activities — verified in pytest.
Activity auto-code generation (ACT-####) uses count_documents — same caveat as iter98 BOQ counter, could collide under concurrent creates. Low risk in single-tenant ERP.

_resource_total for manpower has a slightly surprising fallback chain: when mandays AND rate are non-zero it ignores count_required; otherwise falls back to count*mandays*rate OR count*rate. Spec said total_cost=mandays*daily_rate which is satisfied. Document the fallback in code comment so future maintainers don't accidentally change behavior.

_enrich_resource only fills empty fields (good for round-tripping updates) — but in PUT, since payload defaults overwrite existing values (Pydantic ResourceIn defaults to empty strings/zeros for unspecified fields), an update that omits e.g. designation_name will replace existing populated value with '' before _enrich_resource re-fetches. Currently OK because designation_id is always preserved and _enrich_resource backfills, but worth a comment.

Tools resource total_cost uses count_required (despite the field being semantically more aligned to 'count' for tools). Working as expected but field name reuse could confuse — consider a 'count' alias in next iteration.
No permission gate on resource type filter in GET — accepts arbitrary string for ?type=; harmless since Mongo just won't match, but consider Pydantic Literal enforcement.
Frontend: All three new pages use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly via axios; all data-testids match spec; Add buttons hidden until a project is selected (good UX — prevents creating orphan rows).
seed_data_creation: All pytest fixtures use secrets.token_hex(2) prefixes and tear themselves down (cascade DELETE on root WBS, DELETE on activities and resources). No persistent test data left after suite.
